Beam CAD Viewer uses:

three.js 0.186.0, Copyright 2010-2026 three.js authors, MIT license.
https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js
See THREE-LICENSE.txt.

occt-import-js 0.0.23, by Viktor Kovacs and contributors, LGPL 2.1.
https://github.com/kovacsv/occt-import-js/tree/c2148e54b456b571238d35cac037d304053d64b2
https://www.npmjs.com/package/occt-import-js/v/0.0.23
See OCCT-IMPORT-JS-LICENSE.txt.
The JavaScript importer and WASM are shipped as separate assets. No upstream
source modifications. Source and build instructions are included in the npm
package and the upstream repository. Replace the package dependency and rebuild
Beam to use a modified importer. Inspection and reverse engineering of this
library for debugging modifications are permitted under its license.

The importer embeds Open CASCADE Technology (OCCT), LGPL 2.1 with the
Open CASCADE exception. https://dev.opencascade.org/resources/licensing
OCCT source: https://github.com/Open-Cascade-SAS/OCCT/tree/d2abb6d844231cb8f29be6894440874a4700e4a5
See OCCT-LICENSE.txt and OCCT-EXCEPTION.txt.
The importer repository pins its OCCT source as a git submodule.

The flanged-reducer demo geometry was authored for Beam.
